deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026; late applications are considered through January 15.
deadline.quote: Fall semester application deadline: December 15 | Late applications will be considered through January 15

gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test scores are optional.

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty does not influence admission; the graduate administrator handles admissions queries.
supervisor.quote: While reaching out to a faculty member can help you learn more about their current research, it will not influence the admissions process.

funding.value: The department fellowship (tuition plus monthly stipend) is generally offered to applicants seeking full-time PhD admission.
funding.quote: The fellowship award consists of monthly stipends provided by the department and a full tuition waiver offered by the Office of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies. | Generally, the award is offered to applicants who are seeking full-time admission for the PhD degree as their highest degree.

entry_route.value: An engineering-related undergraduate degree is the listed requirement.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate degree earned or will be earned before entering in an engineering related field.

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not mention a GRE Subject test for this field.
